mechanism_narrative: ERBB2+LIFR forced proximity creates an asymmetric RTK-cytokine hybrid signalosome. ERBB2's kinase transphosphorylates LIFR's intracellular tyrosines, recruiting GRB2-SHC1-SOS (MAPK/ERK) and PIK3R1-GAB1 (PI3K/AKT/mTOR) adaptors that are not efficiently engaged by LIFR's JAKs alone. LIFR's JAK1/2 amplify STAT3 signaling in parallel. The ~20 A flexible GS4 linker brings the 630-aa ERBB2 ECD and 789-aa LIFR ECD into moderate proximity (159 aa asymmetry), favoring the GRB2/SHC1/PI3K cassette over PLCG1 which remains in cis-only mode. The biased output shifts aged muscle toward a young transcriptional phenotype by upregulating contractile structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) via AKT/mTOR and downregulating aged inflammatory IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32) via STAT3-mediated suppression.
